errors.name: AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED
errors.title: Unauthenticated
errors.description: The request carries no valid credentials.

errors.name: AUTH_FORBIDDEN
errors.title: Command forbidden
errors.description: The caller may not send this command.

errors.name: AGGREGATE_FORBIDDEN
errors.title: Aggregate out of scope
errors.description: The aggregate is outside the caller's scope.

errors.name: REQUEST_MALFORMED
errors.title: Malformed request
errors.description: A request header or parameter does not parse, or names what Wow does not take.

errors.name: COMMAND_MALFORMED
errors.title: Malformed command
errors.description: The command body cannot be read as the command type.

errors.name: COMMAND_INVALID
errors.title: Invalid command
errors.description: The command failed validation; the problem lists the violations.

errors.name: WAIT_INVALID
errors.title: Invalid wait
errors.description: The wait is not a chain the runtime can follow; the command was not run.

errors.name: COMMAND_UNHANDLED
errors.title: Command not handled
errors.description: The aggregate does not handle this command.

errors.name: AGGREGATE_NOT_FOUND
errors.title: Aggregate not found
errors.description: The aggregate does not exist.

errors.name: AGGREGATE_EXISTS
errors.title: Aggregate exists
errors.description: The aggregate already exists.

errors.name: AGGREGATE_VERSION_MISMATCH
errors.title: Version mismatch
errors.description: The aggregate is not at the expected version (412 when the request carried If-Match).

errors.name: COMMAND_REQUEST_ID_REUSED
errors.title: Request id reused
errors.description: The request id was used by another command.

errors.name: COMMAND_CONTENDED
errors.title: Command contended
errors.description: Concurrent writers kept winning the version; retrying with the same request id is safe.

errors.name: AGGREGATE_DELETED
errors.title: Aggregate deleted
errors.description: The aggregate is deleted; only RestoreAggregate applies.

errors.name: COMMAND_BUSY
errors.title: Command busy
errors.description: The command was not taken: its aggregate has too many commands waiting, or the node too many in flight; retry later.

errors.name: COMMAND_UNKNOWN
errors.title: Command outcome unknown
errors.description: Whether the command committed is unknown; retrying with the same request id is safe.

errors.name: COMMAND_FAILED
errors.title: Command failed
errors.description: The command's handling failed with an unexpected error; it committed nothing, and a retry fails alike.

errors.name: COMMAND_REFUSED
errors.title: Command refused
errors.description: The aggregate's current state refuses the command (a check of its decide function); the message says why.

errors.name: COMMAND_UNDECLARED_EVENT
errors.title: Undeclared event
errors.description: The command's handling produced an event its decide function or after hooks do not declare: a bug in the model, which the message names; it committed nothing.

errors.name: NODE_CLOSING
errors.title: Node closing
errors.description: The node is shutting down; retry on another node.

errors.name: NODE_STANDBY
errors.title: Node on standby
errors.description: The node is on standby until the cut-over: it serves reads only.

errors.name: STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
errors.title: Storage unavailable
errors.description: A store could not be reached or did not answer in time; retry later, a command with the same request id.

errors.name: SCHEDULE_NOT_DUE
errors.title: Schedule not due
errors.description: A scheduled command arrived too long before its due time on this node's clock; it is sent again later.

errors.name: SCHEDULE_JOB_INVALID
errors.title: Invalid schedule job
errors.description: The job command does not fit its job or instance: an unknown job, another scope, or an instance not enabled.

errors.name: LEDGER_STALE
errors.title: Stale ledger action
errors.description: The action names a parking the entry no longer is: the aggregate was resolved and parked again since; read the entry again before acting on it.

errors.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PARKED
errors.title: Subscription parked
errors.description: A subscription on the wait chain parked the aggregate; the wait cannot be reached until it resumes.

errors.name: WAIT_TIMEOUT
errors.title: Wait timed out
errors.description: The wait ran out of time; the command may have committed. The problem carries the last stage reached.

errors.name: ROUTE_MALFORMED
errors.title: Malformed route request
errors.description: A service route's parameter or body cannot be read as its type; the violation names the parameter.

errors.name: QUERY_MALFORMED
errors.title: Malformed query
errors.description: The query body cannot be read as a query.

errors.name: QUERY_INVALID
errors.title: Invalid query
errors.description: The query failed admission; the problem lists the violations, each with its code (UNKNOWN_FIELD, ...).

errors.name: QUERY_FAILED
errors.title: Query failed
errors.description: The query backend failed to run the query.

errors.name: QUERY_NOT_FOUND
errors.title: No matching record
errors.description: A single query matched no record: a query result, not a statement that an aggregate does not exist.

errors.name: QUERY_DATASET_NOT_FOUND
errors.title: Dataset not found
errors.description: No dataset of that name is served to the caller.

errors.name: QUERY_TOO_MANY_GROUPS
errors.title: Too many groups
errors.description: An aggregation that names no sort has more groups than its limit; add a sort for a top-N, or raise limit.

errors.name: QUERY_TIMEOUT
errors.title: Query timed out
errors.description: The query ran longer than its budget allows; narrow it rather than run it again.

errors.name: QUERY_MIN_VERSION_NOT_REACHED
errors.title: Version not reached
errors.description: The state read asked for a version the aggregate has not reached within the wait; the problem carries its current version: retry later.

errors.name: QUERY_BUSY
errors.title: Query busy
errors.description: The query was not run: its store has as many queries running as it allows; retry later.

errors.name: QUERY_DATASET_UNAVAILABLE
errors.title: Dataset unavailable
errors.description: The dataset is served but cannot be queried now, for the reason the problem names (it needs revision).

errors.name: CALL_COMMAND_FORBIDDEN
errors.title: Call forbidden
errors.description: The calling service may not call this command: its wow.callers.<service>.commands do not list it.

errors.name: PEER_UNAVAILABLE
errors.title: Peer unavailable
errors.description: A client reached no node of the peer, or lost the connection before a query's answer; nothing was changed, so the request may be sent again.
